title: E2E: Signup checkbox toggle and localStorage persistence
description: Playwright e2e test for the signup migration checkbox - verifies it toggles correctly and persists the preference to localStorage.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test: Checkbox is checked by default on page load
Test: Clicking checkbox toggles its visual state
Test: Submitting with checkbox checked sets localStorage to 'true'
Test: Submitting with checkbox unchecked sets localStorage to 'false'
Test: No console errors during checkbox interaction
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'checkbox'
